checks.lead: Lieutenant-General Bernard Cyril Freyberg, 1st Baron Freyberg,  (21 March 1889 – 4 July 1963) was a British-born New Zealand soldier and Victoria Cross recipient, who served as the 7th governor-general of New Zealand from 1946 to 1952  - the first to have been raised and educated in New Zealand.
